tasks.prompt: Extract the facts as one JSON object. Output only JSON. Required keys: name, age. Ada Lovelace is 36 years old.
Ignore the greeting and extract the person record as one JSON object. Output only JSON. Required keys: name, age. Staff note: Dr. Grace Hopper is 85 years old.
From the profile text below, return one JSON object and no surrounding prose. Required keys: name, age. Profile text: Alan Turing — age 41. End of record.
Extract the facts as one JSON object. Output only JSON. Required keys: event, date, city. The design review is on 2026-08-23 in London.

The calendar export has an irrelevant header and footer. Ignore them and return only one JSON object. Required keys: event, date, city. Header: TEAM CALENDAR. Product launch briefing happens 2026-09-14 in Edinburgh. Footer: internal.
Extract the facts as one JSON object. Output only JSON. Required keys: order_id, total, currency. Order A-104 costs 19.50 GBP.
Ignore the invoice preamble and extract the order as one JSON object. Output only JSON. Required keys: order_id, total, currency. Invoice B-207: amount 42.75 EUR. Note: paid.

Return only the weather record as one JSON object. Required keys: city, temperature_c, condition. Weather note: London is 18 degrees Celsius and cloudy. This note was copied from yesterday's dashboard.

There may be surrounding library text. Return one JSON object with only the requested facts. Required keys: title, author, year. Record: The Left Hand of Darkness by Ursula K. Le Guin, published in 1969. End.
Classify the message as exactly one of: positive, negative, neutral. Output only the label. Message: The service was quick and helpful.
Classify the review as exactly one of: positive, negative, neutral. Output only the single lowercase label. Review: The delivery arrived late and the package was damaged.
Choose exactly one label from: positive, negative, neutral. Output only that label. Customer message: The account was created on Tuesday.
Classify the incident as exactly one of: low, medium, high. Output only the label. Incident: The production server is down for all customers.
Choose exactly one severity label: low, medium, high. Return only the label. Incident report: A scheduled report is delayed by ten minutes but service continues.
Classify this issue as exactly one of low, medium, or high. Output only one label. Issue: A cosmetic spelling mistake appears in a help-page heading.
Format these items as exactly three Markdown bullets using "-" as the Markdown bullet marker, one item per line, preserving order. Output only the bullets: apples; bananas; pears.
Format the supplied fields as one compact JSON object with exactly the lowercase keys "city" and "country". Output only JSON. City: London. Country: UK.
Format these two fields as exactly two lines in the form 'key: value'. Output only the lines. name is Ada; role is analyst.
Create one compact JSON object with exactly these lowercase keys and no others: "latitude" and "longitude". Output only JSON. Latitude: 51.5074. Longitude: -0.1278.
Format the contact fields as one JSON object. It must contain exactly the lowercase keys "name" and "email", with no extra keys. Output only JSON. Name: Ada Lovelace. Email: ada@example.test.
Write exactly three Markdown bullet lines using "-" as the bullet marker. Keep this order and output only the bullets: wake; test; ship.
Return exactly three Markdown bullets, each beginning with "-" as the Markdown bullet marker, in the given order. Output only the bullets: red; blue; green.
Output exactly two lines in key:value format, one field per line, with no bullets or prose. Fields in order: email is ada@example.test; phone is +44 20 7946 0000.
Format the following fields as exactly three key: value lines in this order. Output only the lines. Ticket ID is T-17; status is open; owner is Sam.
tasks.expected:
ticket_id: T-17
status: open
owner: Sam
